name: search_fonts
description: Search the font catalog that the cloud video renderer can load (Google Fonts library + project-bundled custom fonts). Use this when an export reports unsupported fonts or when picking fonts for motion-graphic items. Returns the canonical family name you use verbatim as `fontFamily` in motion-graphic code or properties. Substring-matches on the family name AND on native-name aliases (case- and punctuation-insensitive), so you can look up bundled Chinese fonts by their Chinese name — pass a fragment such as "inter", "playfair", "noto sc", "新青年", or "得意黑".

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

query.description: Substring to match against font family names or their native-name aliases (e.g. a Chinese font name). Case- and punctuation-insensitive.
